test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Parts of the following sentence are given as options. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

A lot of food we serve are wasted.
solution: The erroneous part is **'are wasted'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • Here, **'is wasted' **should be used instead of **'are wasted'.** • A **singular** subject requires a **singular** verb, and a **plural** **subject** requires a **plural** **verb**. • Here, **'a lot of food'** is **a singular subject.** • Hence, it should be followed by **a singular verb.** • *Example: A lot of money **has **been wasted in our town.* **Correct Sentence:__** *A lot of food we serve is wasted.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • यहाँ पर** 'are wasted' **के स्थान पर** 'is wasted' **का प्रयोग होना चाहिए। • **Singular subject **के लिए **Singular verb** की आवश्यकता होती है, और **Plural subject **के लिए** Plural verb **की आवश्यकता होती है। • यहाँ,** 'a lot of food' **एक **singular subject **है। • इसलिए, इसके बाद **singular verb** होनी चाहिए। • *Example: A lot of money **has **been wasted in our town. * de:T16c5, The correct answer is **'People still believe in superstitions'.**
